content: Talk to yourself once in a day, otherwise you may miss meeting an intelligent person in this world.
author: Swami Vivekananda
explanation: Vivekananda highlights the vital practice of regular inward dialogue. In the constant clamor of social engagements and outward demands, we often neglect communion with our own deeper wisdom and inner intellect.
practicalInsight: Schedule a dedicated five-minute conversation with yourself at the end of the day. Ask your inner self what you learned and what you need to align tomorrow.
reflectionPrompt: When was the last time I truly listened to my own inner voice in quiet communion?
